capabilities: Automatically save each note edit to a per-file history file
Browse stored edits via calendar, timeline, and dropdown views
Diff edits against previous versions in side-by-side, top-bottom, inline, or timeline views
Copy previous edits or parts of them back into the note
Limit history by edit interval, edit count, and edit age
extras: The manifest mentions restoring previous edits, but the README lists 'Restore a given edit' under TODO, so currently edits can only be diffed and copied. README documents the internal .edtz zip/diff-match-patch file format.
intentEvidence: This is similar to the File Recovery core plugin with the following advantages
problem: Obsidian's File Recovery snapshot mechanism is limited to certain file types, uses a closed format, and offers no way to browse, diff, or access individual edit snapshots externally.

summary: Edit-tracking plugin that automatically saves every note edit to a per-file history (.edtz) file that can be browsed, diffed, and copied.
